milestones.title: Qualified development baseline
exit_criteria: Create/edit, reuse across two views, search/usages/impact, save/recover/reopen on one reproducible candidate.

milestones.title: Presentation recovery
exit_criteria: Recover an independent native document, inspect old presentation, map selected occurrences, Apply once, save/reopen, and retain originals.

milestones.title: Craft workspace behavior
exit_criteria: Complete baseline by menu and keyboard; rearrange, restart/reset workspace, and cancel operations without losing drafts.

milestones.title: Structural modeling semantics
exit_criteria: Author a typed subsystem with two instances, ports and exchange; reuse, override, clone, move and delete with valid references and recovery.

milestones.title: Requirements and validation
exit_criteria: Trace a requirement hierarchy to a subsystem and evidence, find a known coverage gap, repair a seeded fault, compare matrix and diagram.

milestones.title: Behavior and analysis
exit_criteria: Author/run bounded behavior, evaluate dimensioned constraints and Boolean assessment, attach receipt, and demonstrate input-change staleness.

milestones.title: Interchange and reusable outputs
exit_criteria: Inspect an explicit source set, admit/export supported constructs, reopen independently, review library update conflicts, generate diagrams/reports.

milestones.title: Shared Craft UI experience
exit_criteria: Complete the engineering workflow across pinned interaction references, themes, locales, keyboard-only and accessibility checks.

milestones.title: Review and collaboration
exit_criteria: Two authenticated clients edit offline, reconnect, review conflicts, merge and publish a fixed-revision stakeholder review in a local harness.

milestones.title: Target-specific closure
exit_criteria: Every selected edition/version/platform capability passes its independent oracle; missing coverage blocks parity claims. Production acceptance is separate.

ordering: Conservative serial integration order; dependencies can be narrowed only after interface review.
expansion_rule: P48, P50, P57 and P58 are decomposition gates: one locale/font adapter, platform/backend, external engine or construct family per child PR. Their children must be enumerated before scheduling implementation.
